description_en: You can call this operation to retrieve the details of an audio audit
description_zh: 调用本接口获取音频审核详情
name: GetMediaAuditAudioResultDetail

parameters.description_en: The audio ID. You can query the audio ID in the video-on-demand console or obtain the audio ID from the response to a call of the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation.
parameters.description_zh: 音频ID。可通过点播控制台查询音频ID或通过[SearchMedia](~~86044~~)接口请求后会返回音频ID。
parameters.help_en: The audio ID. You can query the audio ID in the video-on-demand console or obtain the audio ID from the response to a call of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html operation

parameters.description_en: The page number. This parameter is optional. If you leave this parameter empty, all results are returned without paging.
